description: This file provides a handler class for integrating with Google AI Studio Files API within the litellm project. It includes methods to construct upload URLs, transform file creation requests, and parse responses from Gemini's file upload API, specifically tailored for Gemini's platform and semantics.

classes.name: GoogleAIStudioFilesHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing file uploads to Google AI Studio Files API, extending GeminiModelInfo and BaseFilesConfig.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the upload URL for the API, requiring api_base and api_key.

methods.name: List[OpenAICreateFileRequestOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns an empty list, indicating no specific optional parameters are supported.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps optional parameters for OpenAI requests; currently returns input optional_params unchanged.

methods.name: dict transform_create_file_request( self, model: str, create_file_data: CreateFileRequest, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms an OpenAI-style file creation request into the Gemini format, preparing headers and data for the resumable upload process.

methods.name: OpenAIFileObject transform_create_file_response( self, model: Optional[str], raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Parses Gemini's response to a file upload to produce an OpenAI-style FileObject, handling JSON parsing and error logging.
